name: legal-page
useFor: Use as a starting point for terms, privacy or other policy pages. Replace the sample text with your counsel's and keep each heading's id in the contents.
documentation:
Composed from `SiteHeader`, `PageHeader`, `Item` (the contents' links), `Prose` and `SiteFooter`. The contents stay in
view on wide screens and sit over the text on a phone.
source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice; the structure from agentcard.sh/terms
title: Legal page
description: Legal page template (terms or privacy) with the header, the title and last updated date, contents beside the text, and the footer.
